text:
michael.ae: Quick sync — Pendulum Health just kicked back the RFP. They want a short POC (2 weeks), a filled security questionnaire, and a capability matrix comparing our Dedicated vs Private options. Need proposed SOW + pricing by EOD Fri. attaching initial matrix we drafted.

 dan.se: Got it. Do they require HSM-backed key storage for model keys & logs?

 michael.ae: Yes — they flagged HSM + SOC2 + data residency (EU). Also asked about on-prem option for airway-gapped environments.

 sophie.se: For the POC: what are their traffic/latency targets? We need seq lengths and RPS to size Dedicated pool.

 michael.ae: They said "interactive triage" use case: ~75 concurrent users, typical prompt ~300 tokens, target p95 latency <400ms. RPS estimate = 20–30.

 ana.eng: For that profile we should recommend 2x A100s dedicated or Private with 1x H100 and autoscale. Will run a quick perf sweep tomorrow morning and post numbers.

 ryan.pricing: Pricing question: do they want committed reserved capacity or on-demand? SOW will differ a lot. Any clues from their procurement?

 michael.ae: Procurement prefers a 3-month pilot with month-to-month conversion, paying for reserved baseline + overage. They also requested a TCO comparison in the matrix.

 sophie.se: I'll update the capability matrix to include: model versioning, KV cache support, quantization options, enterprise observability, KMS/HSM integration, and regression alerting. Also note function-calling support.

 sec-bot: New file uploaded: pendulum_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (link: https://drive.redwood/pendulum/sec_q_v1).

 dan.se: I'll take the security questionnaire. Quick answers: SOC2 scope — we can provide attestation for Redwood cloud; for Private deployments we recommend customer-provided KMS/HSM options. Need legal to confirm encryption SLA.

 ana.eng: Regarding on-prem: the Private package can be installed inside their network but requires customer infra for orchestration (k8s) — we have an airgap installer. Will document required ports and operator steps in the POC runbook.

 ryan.pricing: Draft pricing approach: Pilot (3 months): Reserved baseline 100k tokens/day at $0.004/token + Dedicated baseline $X/day for 2x GPUs; overage billed at on-demand rate. Will calculate exact $X after throughput numbers.

 sophie.se: Note for capability matrix: add a row for "graceful fallback" — our routing policy can fall back to cheaper model variants automatically. Pendulum cares about uptime and predictable UX.

 michael.ae: Good. Action items: 1) ana to run perf sweep and post latency/throughput numbers (tomorrow AM). 2) dan to fill sec questionnaire and call out any gaps (EOD tomorrow). 3) ryan to assemble pricing table and TCO comparison (EOD Fri). 4) sophie to update matrix and POC runbook (EOD Thu).

 dan.se: Quick Q — do we have a templated HSM answer for RFPs (FIPS level, supported providers)?

 sec-bot: HSM template is at https://drive.redwood/templates/hsm_faq.md — we support AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM, and on-prem PKCS#11 integrations. FIPS 140-2 L3 certified guidance included.

 ana.eng: Putting a note in the runbook: prefix caching will likely cut token cost ~25% for their top 30% flows. I'll include sample cache hit rates and how to configure prefix TTL.

 ryan.pricing: If prefix cache reduces tokens by 25% that should materially change TCO — I'll include a cached vs uncached scenario.

 michael.ae: One blocker: legal asked about exported logs — Pendulum requires logs retained for 180 days in EU only. Can we scope that?

 dan.se: Yes — retention window configurable per-customer. For hosted we'd store in EU region; Private can use local storage. I'll document retention options in the security answers.

 sophie.se: Also adding checklist for POC acceptance criteria: smoke latency <500ms, qualitative outputs pass 80% of their eval prompts, integration using function-calls (two example tools) + SSO integration.

 ana.eng: I'll add a sample canary deploy config and a simple stress test script (wrk + tokenized workload) to reproduce numbers.

 deploy-bot: File uploaded: pendulum_poc_runbook_v0.1.md

 michael.ae: Perfect. Who can own the draft RFP packet for Pendulum? I can compile, but need the sec answers + matrix + pricing by Friday.

 dan.se: I'll prioritize the sec Qs and ping legal for export controls.

 ryan.pricing: I'll pull numbers and push a draft pricing spreadsheet by EOD Thu so we can iterate.

 sophie.se: I'll finish the capability matrix and POC runbook by Thu morning and link into the RFP packet.

 michael.ae: Thanks team — let's do a 20m sync Thu 10:30 to review drafts. @here please flag if you can't make it. :calendar:

 dan.se: 10:30 works for me.

 ana.eng: Can do.

 ryan.pricing: I may be on another call, will send notes if I can't attend.

 michelle.ae: (upload) pendulum_initial_matrix_v0.2.csv

 dan.se: Thanks — I'll start filling the questionnaire now.

 end of thread"
